Testing
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(RSocrata)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# Get the data from NYC 311 service requests (e.g., first 100 rows)
data <- read.socrata("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/erm2-nwe9.json?$limit=100")

```

```{r}
head(data)
str(data)
```

```{r}


# checking for NA values in specific columns
sum(is.na(data$created_date))
sum(is.na(data$complaint_type))
sum(is.na(data$latitude))  # Check for missing latitude/longitude

```

```{r}

#convert borough column to a factor since it is a categorical variable
data$borough <- as.factor(data$borough)

#bar chart
ggplot(data, aes(x = borough)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "pink") + #By default, geom_bar() counts occurrences of each unique value in borough.
  labs(title = "Complaint Count by Borough",
       x = "Borough", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

```
